block.astralvigil.convergence_altar.desc: Binds the offerings of its pedestals with starlight.
block.astralvigil.fallen_star.desc: Its light has not yet learned that it has fallen.

block.astralvigil.mirror.desc: Turns beams from any side towards its face.
block.astralvigil.pedestal.desc: Holds one offering for the Convergence Altar.
block.astralvigil.prism.desc: Splits pure starlight into Sol, Luna and Stella.
block.astralvigil.star_anchor.desc: Lay out a learned constellation, fill with starlight, then touch an anchor.

item.astralvigil.astral_shard.desc: A splinter of the firmament, still humming with starlight.
item.astralvigil.astrolabe.desc: Reads the heavens. Hums towards fallen stars.
item.astralvigil.codex_caelestis.desc: Ilyra's chronicle of the firmament. Grows with your research.
item.astralvigil.halo_of_dawn.desc: Carried: abilities cost less starlight and the Eclipse's gaze slides off you.
item.astralvigil.seraph_feather.desc: Use to bind Seraph Wings to yourself; use again to show or hide them.
item.astralvigil.star_chart.desc: Connect the stars of a revealed constellation to learn it.
item.astralvigil.umbral_sigil.desc: In the Firmament, bearing all four Marks: call down the Eclipse.
lore.astralvigil.fragment_1.text: Before there were Watchers there was only the sky, and the sky was not kind. We were five lights who chose to stand guard.
lore.astralvigil.fragment_1.title: Before the Watch
lore.astralvigil.fragment_10.text: The watchers sealed their treasures with our signs. Only one who has traced a sign in the sky may open what it guards.
lore.astralvigil.fragment_10.title: Locks of Stars
lore.astralvigil.fragment_11.text: The towers did not fall to war. They fell because the watchers grew tired, and a tired watcher looks away.
lore.astralvigil.fragment_11.title: The Fall of the Towers
lore.astralvigil.fragment_12.text: Starlight is not the light of the stars. It is the light the stars give back to those who look at them.
lore.astralvigil.fragment_12.title: Starlight
lore.astralvigil.fragment_13.text: Orrin split light to understand it. He found three of us inside. He did not find the fifth, and that should have warned him.
lore.astralvigil.fragment_13.title: The Prism's Lesson
lore.astralvigil.fragment_14.text: What is bound in symmetry holds. What is bound in haste breaks, and something always notices the break.
lore.astralvigil.fragment_14.title: On Convergence
lore.astralvigil.fragment_15.text: A blade remembers what it was used for. Use it well, and it will remember you.
lore.astralvigil.fragment_15.title: Living Steel
lore.astralvigil.fragment_16.text: Every time you draw on the sky, the sky looks back. Most of it is kind. The part that is not has been waiting a long time.
lore.astralvigil.fragment_16.title: The Gaze
lore.astralvigil.fragment_17.text: The Eclipse cannot yet cross. It sends echoes – thin, angry shapes that remember being light.
lore.astralvigil.fragment_17.title: Echoes
lore.astralvigil.fragment_18.text: Where its gaze rests too long, the world forgets how to be stone and remembers how to be night.
lore.astralvigil.fragment_18.title: Void Glass
lore.astralvigil.fragment_19.text: Lay our signs upon the ground in starlit stone, and the sky will lean closer to see them. While it leans, the dark cannot.
lore.astralvigil.fragment_19.title: Anchors
lore.astralvigil.fragment_2.text: Solenne took the day. She burns hottest for those who stand against the restless dead.
lore.astralvigil.fragment_2.title: Solenne
lore.astralvigil.fragment_20.text: Something has torn the firmament. I have checked our binding a thousand times. It holds. So what tore the sky?
lore.astralvigil.fragment_20.title: The Rift
lore.astralvigil.fragment_21.text: The stars that fall are not lost. They are sent. Someone wanted you to find them.
lore.astralvigil.fragment_21.title: Falling Stars
lore.astralvigil.fragment_22.text: Beyond the clouds lies the Firmament itself – islands of stone that forgot to fall. Our sanctums are there, waiting for an aspirant.
lore.astralvigil.fragment_22.title: Above
lore.astralvigil.fragment_23.text: A seeker looks up. An aspirant climbs. I hope you climb.
lore.astralvigil.fragment_23.title: Seeker, Aspirant
lore.astralvigil.fragment_24.text: If you are reading this, the binding is failing, and I am no longer able to write. Finish the chronicle for me.
lore.astralvigil.fragment_24.title: Last Entry
lore.astralvigil.fragment_3.text: Vael took the night. He does not shout. He waits, and when he looses, he does not miss.
lore.astralvigil.fragment_3.title: Vael
lore.astralvigil.fragment_4.text: Orrin took the stars themselves and hammered them into their places. Every constellation still bears the marks of his anvil.
lore.astralvigil.fragment_4.title: Orrin
lore.astralvigil.fragment_5.text: I took the memory. Someone must remember what the sky has seen, or the sky forgets itself.
lore.astralvigil.fragment_5.title: Ilyra
lore.astralvigil.fragment_6.text: The fifth took the space between. We did not understand that the space between is hungry.
lore.astralvigil.fragment_6.title: The Fifth
lore.astralvigil.fragment_7.text: When the fifth light swallowed the sun for the first time, we called it an accident. The second time, we gave it a name.
lore.astralvigil.fragment_7.title: The First Eclipse
lore.astralvigil.fragment_8.text: Four of us held the Eclipse behind the firmament. It took all our light. It still does.
lore.astralvigil.fragment_8.title: The Binding
lore.astralvigil.fragment_9.text: We taught the people below to watch the sky with us. They built towers of dark stone and lenses of glass, and for a while they kept the watch well.
lore.astralvigil.fragment_9.title: The Observatories
message.astralvigil.astrolabe.starfall: The astrolabe hums: a fallen star lies %s blocks to the %s.
message.astralvigil.codex.no_patchouli: The pages are blank. (Install Patchouli to read the Codex.)
message.astralvigil.constellation.reveal: A new constellation reveals itself on your Star Chart: %s
message.astralvigil.cosmetics.locked: Developer cosmetics are reserved for the Astral Vigil team.
message.astralvigil.eclipse.defeated: The Eclipse falls. For a moment, every star burns brighter.
message.astralvigil.eclipse.phase2: The Eclipse splinters – its echoes join the fight!
message.astralvigil.eclipse.phase3: The broken halo flares. Find cover from the Umbral Nova!
message.astralvigil.firmament.arrive: You rise above the clouds. The gate behind you leads home.
message.astralvigil.firmament.missing: The Firmament is closed on this server.
message.astralvigil.gate.hint: The key yearns for a gate: build a closed, upright frame of one kind of gate block, then set the key into it.
message.astralvigil.gate.incomplete: The frame is not closed (opening at least 2 wide and 3 tall, at most 21).
message.astralvigil.gate.lit.archive: The Archive Gate opens before Ilyra's Endless Library.
message.astralvigil.gate.lit.astral: The Astral Gate opens onto the Firmament's hub.
message.astralvigil.gate.lit.lunar: The Lunar Gate opens onto Vael's Moon Arena.
message.astralvigil.gate.lit.prism: The Prism Gate opens before Orrin's Prism Observatory.
message.astralvigil.gate.lit.solar: The Solar Gate opens at the foot of Solenne's Sun Spire.
message.astralvigil.gate.lit.umbral: The Umbral Gate tears open. The Throne of the Eclipse lies beyond.
message.astralvigil.gate.umbral_marks: The Umbral Gate stays dark: carry all four Watchers' Marks.
message.astralvigil.gaze.stage.1: You feel watched from between the stars.
message.astralvigil.gaze.stage.2: The dark between the stars has noticed you.
message.astralvigil.gaze.stage.3: Where you walk, the world forgets the light.
message.astralvigil.gaze.stage.4: The Eclipse is looking straight at you.
message.astralvigil.gaze.surge: The sun dims. Something reaches through.
message.astralvigil.gear.no_stance: No sigil set in your gear.
message.astralvigil.gear.socket_failed: The sigil does not fit – wrong gear, already set, or no free slot.
message.astralvigil.lock.opened: You trace %s – the seal dissolves into light.
message.astralvigil.lock.sealed: The lock does not yield. It bears the sign of %s.
message.astralvigil.ritual.complete: %s shines down on you. The Eclipse's gaze recedes.
message.astralvigil.ritual.no_pattern: These anchors form no constellation you have learned.
message.astralvigil.ritual.no_sky: An anchor cannot see the sky.
message.astralvigil.starfall.seen: A star tears through the night sky and falls to the %s!
message.astralvigil.trial.complete: %s accepts your trial and grants you their Mark.
message.astralvigil.trial.expired: Your trial has lapsed. Speak to the Watcher again.
message.astralvigil.umbral.marks: The sigil needs all four Watchers' Marks to answer.
message.astralvigil.umbral.not_here: The sigil is cold. Only on the Umbral Throne - reached through an Umbral Gate - can the Eclipse be called.
message.astralvigil.umbral.peaceful: The Eclipse does not answer in a peaceful world.
screen.astralvigil.cosmetics.locked: Reserved for the Astral Vigil team
screen.astralvigil.cosmetics.subtitle: Developer cosmetics - visible to everyone
screen.astralvigil.star_chart.hint: Click a star, then another to draw a line
sigil.astralvigil.aegis.desc: Wrap yourself in a ward of starlight.
sigil.astralvigil.dawn.desc: A burst of daylight: undead burn, the rest are revealed.
sigil.astralvigil.flash.desc: Dash forward on a streak of light.
sigil.astralvigil.precision.desc: Your next arrow strikes far harder and marks its target.
sigil.astralvigil.undertow.desc: Your next shot drags its target towards you.
trial.astralvigil.ilyra.hint: Find the Trial Beacon in the reading room at the heart of the Endless Library - a dark, roofed maze.
trial.astralvigil.ilyra.intro: %s: "Every library is a labyrinth. Find the page I hid."
trial.astralvigil.orrin.hint: Three bays, three receptors: turn the mirrors (right-click, sneak to turn back) until Stella light reaches all three Trial Receptors at once.
trial.astralvigil.orrin.intro: %s: "Light is metal that has not yet been bent. Bend it."
trial.astralvigil.solenne.hint: Climb the Sun Spire - a hundred blocks of single steps - and touch the Trial Beacon on its crown. Gold pads are checkpoints; magma pads burn.
trial.astralvigil.solenne.intro: %s: "Climb towards the sun, aspirant. Do not look down."
trial.astralvigil.vael.hint: Light all ten Moon Targets with your arrows - four float on far islets - while Eclipse Echoes rise against you.
trial.astralvigil.vael.intro: %s: "Ten moons. The shadows will not wait for you."
